resources.string: Use any OpenAI-compatible server instead of OpenAI. Conversations, audio and selected text go to this server, and it bills or limits usage. Voice takes turns: speak, pause, then Mural answers. Web search isn\'t available.
API key (leave empty to keep the saved key)
Topic search needs OpenAI\'s web search, which your custom endpoint doesn\'t offer. Choose a theme instead.
Your custom endpoint bills or limits usage, so its own dashboard or logs are authoritative. The time limit is local, not a billing cap.
Audio and selected text go to your custom endpoint while you practise, under that server\'s retention rules. Raw audio is not saved by Mural.
Enter the API key without spaces or line breaks.
Enter an https:// base URL and a chat model.
Add a transcription model, speech model and voice for your custom endpoint in Settings to start a conversation.
Your custom endpoint returned an incomplete or unexpected response. Check its API style and models.
Your custom endpoint couldn\'t complete the request (HTTP %1$d). Check its settings.
